description: Sends the message prepared with a confirmation_token to the SOS Flights team, after the traveller confirmed it. The team's reply appears in the case status and on the case page.

confirmation_token.description: confirmation_token from the prepare step, for example sc_3qJ8vT0kPzL1mW6xR2aYbQ. Valid for 15 minutes.

idempotency_key.description: Key that makes a retry safe: a repeated key returns the first result. Defaults to one key per confirmation_token.

name: sos_send_message
title: Send the message to the team
